title: Service Contracts: settling an accrued volume rebate, and forfeiture on default
content:
## Scope
This policy of the Aurelia Hanse Line (AHL) Service Contracts product governs the settlement of volume rebate that has been accrued on a contract, and the forfeiture of unsettled rebate when the line terminates a contract for default. The contract's rebate balance is the rebate earned and not yet settled: accruals add to it, settlements reduce it.

## Formal clauses
1. Accrued rebate is settled by the tier's settlement method, credit note or cash, once the unsettled accruals reach the tier's minimum payout.
2. Each settlement refers to the accrual it settles.
3. A contract terminated for default forfeits its unsettled rebate.

## Settlement threshold (hypothetical minimum payout of 500 USD, for illustration only)
| Unsettled accruals | Minimum payout reached? | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 480.00 USD | no | not yet settled; the accruals remain unsettled |
| 500.00 USD | yes, reaching includes equality | settled by the tier's method |
| 620.00 USD | yes | settled by the tier's method |

## Points of judgement
**How is the rebate paid out?** By the tier's settlement method only: a credit note or cash, as the tier sets.

**The line terminated a contract for default while 1250.00 USD of accrued rebate was unsettled (hypothetical figure).** That unsettled rebate is forfeited.

**Does each settlement stand alone?** No. Every settlement refers to the accrual it settles.
